'''Donald Maurice Broom''' (born 14 July 1942) is an English [[biologist]] and emeritus professor of [[animal welfare]] at the [[University of Cambridge]].<ref>
{{cite web
 |url         = http://www.vet.cam.ac.uk/research/investigators/broom.html
 |title       = Cambridge Veterinary School: Research investigators
 |publisher   = [[University of Cambridge]] Veterinary School
 |access-date  = 21 January 2010
 |url-status     = dead
 |archive-url  = https://web.archive.org/web/20100104072431/http://www.vet.cam.ac.uk/research/investigators/broom.html
 |archive-date = 4 January 2010}}</ref><ref>{{cite book | last=Garner | first=R. | title=Animals, Politics and Morality: Second Edition | publisher=Manchester University Press | series=Animals, Politics, and Morality | year=2004 | isbn=978-0-7190-6621-4 | url=https://books.google.com/books?id=GBX3in2YXnsC&pg=PA64 | access-date=7 Aug 2023 | page=64}}</ref>

==Education and career==
Broom studied at [[Whitgift School]], and at [[St Catharine's College, Cambridge]], where he gained a [[B.A.]] in 1964, and a [[PhD]] in 1967. From 1967 to 1986, he was lecturer and then reader at the [[University of Reading]].<ref name="orcid.org"/> 

Broom was appointed to the first professorship in animal welfare at the University of Cambridge in 1986, and has written widely on sentience in animals, and on the ethics and morality of animal welfare.<ref>{{Cite journal|url=https://doi.org/10.2527/1991.69104167x|title=Animal welfare: concepts and measurement2|first=D. M.|last=Broom|date=1 October 1991|journal=Journal of Animal Science|volume=69|issue=10|pages=4167–4175|doi=10.2527/1991.69104167x|pmid=1778832 |url-access=subscription}}</ref><ref name="The Gospel Coalition">{{Cite web|url=https://www.thegospelcoalition.org/themelios/review/the-evolution-of-morality-and-religion/|title=THE EVOLUTION OF MORALITY AND RELIGION|website=The Gospel Coalition}}</ref>

During his career in Cambridge, Broom was a fellow of [[St Catharine's College, Cambridge]], and a professor in the veterinary school. On retirement in 2009, he was elected to an emeritus fellowship at St Catharine's college.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.caths.cam.ac.uk/directory/professor-donald-broom|title=Professor Donald Broom &#124; St Catharine's College, Cambridge|website=www.caths.cam.ac.uk}}</ref>

== Selected works ==
* ''[[Biology of Behaviour]]'' (1981)
* ''[[Farm Animal Behaviour and Welfare]]'', with [[Andrew F. Fraser]] (1990)
* ''[[Stress and Animal Welfare]]'' with [[Kenneth G. Johnson]] (1993)
* ''[http://www.huntinginquiry.gov.uk/evidence/broomreport.htm The welfare of deer, foxes, mink and hares subjected to hunting by humans: a review] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20080727011056/http://www.huntinginquiry.gov.uk/evidence/broomreport.htm |date=27 July 2008 }}'' (2000) Evidence to the [[Burns Inquiry]]
* ''The Evolution of Morality and Religion'' (2003)<ref name="The Gospel Coalition"/>
* ''[[Sentience and Animal Welfare]]'' (2014).
* ''[[Domestic Animal Behaviour and Welfare]]'', with [[Andrew F. Fraser]] (2015), 5th edition.
